study: Olson et al. 2012 (Pathway Project cognitive-strategies PD, SAUSD; AERJ 49(2); IES R305W06016)
eval_evidence: Authored/conducted by the Pathway Project developers (Carol Booth Olson and colleagues, UCI Writing Project) under their own IES grant; no independent third-party evaluator -- the developers ran the RCT and the impact analyses.
developer_evidence: The Pathway PD (46h training + coaching) was delivered by the Pathway Project developers/UCI Writing Project team (the program's developers), supported by experienced Pathway teacher-coaches.
cascade_evidence: Developers/UCI Writing Project team led the training directly for the SAUSD secondary English teachers; veteran-teacher coaches provided support but the developer team delivered the PD (no intermediary org trained between developer and teachers).
counterfactual_evidence: Control was NOT pure BAU: control teachers received the typical 26h of district PD, while Pathway teachers got that SAME 26h PLUS 46h Pathway PD; the control thus got an active (district) PD program. Coded active_or_contaminated.
coaching_evidence: PD is primarily 46h of workshop/release-day training plus coaching from experienced Pathway teachers; the report does not document recurring (monthly+/biweekly+) in-class coaching cycles -> occasional.
student_dose_evidence: Pure teacher PD; only the teachers' own ELA (interpretive reading/analytical writing) instruction changes. No tutoring, pull-out, or added student-facing dose.
maturity_evidence: Extracted/headline wave is Year 2 (2008-09) end-of-treatment; teachers had completed a prior implementation year (Year 1, 2007-08, replicating an earlier d=.35), so the measured cohort's teachers are in their 2nd year -> mature.
